Mr Hardie was an undergraduate at the Royal College of Art when his friend, photographer Stephen Goldblatt, recommended him to Led Zeppelin in 1969. After rejecting his initial ideas, guitarist Jimmy Page suggested that Mr Hardie adapt the photo of the Hindenburg disaster.
